en.headline: Minibus hits elderly couple at Ma On Shan terminus
en.dek: The husband was left unconscious with a head injury and the driver was arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving causing grievous bodily harm.
body: A scheduled minibus struck an elderly couple at the Bayshore Towers minibus terminus on Sai Sha Road in Ma On Shan on Monday afternoon, leaving the husband unconscious with a head injury.

The crash was reported at about 2pm. Both pedestrians suffered head injuries. Ambulances took the couple to Prince of Wales Hospital for emergency treatment. The husband did not regain consciousness at the scene; his wife remained awake.

Police arrested the minibus driver on suspicion of dangerous driving causing grievous bodily harm. Officers said they were still investigating the cause of the accident and have not released the couple's names or ages.
The windscreen on the left of the vehicle's front was cracked. A tow truck later removed the damaged minibus from the terminus while the inquiry continued.

zh.headline: 馬鞍山小巴撞傷年長夫婦 司機涉危險駕駛被捕
zh.dek: 丈夫頭部受傷陷入昏迷，司機被控危險駕駛導致他人身體受嚴重傷害。
body: 一輛專線小巴星期一午約在馬鞍山西沙路海灣花園小巴總站撞倒一對年長夫婦，丈夫頭部受傷陷入昏迷。
意外約於下午2時發生，兩名途人均頭部受傷，救護車將他們送往威爾斯親王醫院急救。丈夫在現場未有恢復意識，妻子則保持清醒。
警方以涉嫌危險駕駛導致他人身體受嚴重傷害拘捕小巴司機，表示仍在調查意外原因，暫未公布夫婦姓名及年齡。
小巴左邊擋風玻璃出現裂紋，拖吊車其後將損毀小巴拖離總站，調查工作仍在進行。
